findings.quote: Japan took the initiative to launch the Hiroshima AI Process, establishing the world's first international world's first international principles and code of conduct to govern generative AI.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI opportunities, security and misinformation risks, and the Hiroshima AI governance process.

findings.quote: In parallel, Japan has been working with like-minded partners and Global South partners to co-create a safe, secure, and trustworthy AI ecosystem and will enhance cooperation on safety to respond to the risks of highly capable frontier AI.
findings.rationale: Commits to international frontier AI safety cooperation and hosting an AI summit.
